call_points.text: Management expects growth on a quarter-on-quarter basis for FY27 but did not provide specific guidance.
Around 400 keys (rooms) expected to be added in the next 12-15 months from Gwalior, Dehradun, Dwarka, Nashik, Rishikesh, and Mandvi Kutch.
Target is to take EBITDA margins up to 30% in the next two to three years through revenue growth and cost rationalization.
Net debt is at ₹38 Cr with comfortable leverage; can raise up to ₹300 Cr debt if needed.
New CFO Milind Wadekar joined with over 30 years of experience, including 20+ years in hospitality.
